title: Question on the page "hits"
body:

I am using hit-template for results, but i am unable to apply condition. If record does not contain profile_image then my view gets disturb. How to use image thumbnail if profile_image does not exist. We didn't find any results for the search \"{{query}}\"
" } }) ); Hit Template:
